scope: The complete residual 49-token predhodn-/prědhodn- family in the four Latin sources, audited together with the one existing poprědnyh control from EDIT-0111.
choice: Normalize 47 adjective uses morphology-preservingly to the official type-1 poprědny family. Recast the two adverbial uses prědhodno/Prědhodno at base lines 7547 and 9979 to official type-1 raněje/Raněje.
motivation: All 47 adjective contexts denote previous or preceding paragraphs, results, objects, fields, ideals, modules or ordered elements. The official dictionary offers exact type-1 poprědnji/poprědny for this semantic slot, while prědhodny is type 2. The two adverbs mean previously/earlier rather than an inflected adjective and therefore require the established type-1 adverb raněje.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining the mixed predhodn-/prědhodn- source layer was rejected because it preserves unaccented variants and an official type-2 doublet beside the already selected type-1 house form poprědny.
Blindly changing all 49 tokens to a poprědn- stem was rejected because base lines 7547 and 9979 are adverbial and would yield an unsupported poprědno.
prědnje was rejected for the two adverbs because its official meaning is beforehand/in advance, not previously mentioned or previously accepted.
prědtym was rejected because the contexts do not point to a discrete before-that event; raněje is the exact official type-1 earlier/previously adverb.
ranš- was rejected for the adjectives because the mathematical relation is previous/preceding in an exposition, chain or fixed order rather than merely earlier in time.

evidence.official_dictionary: Official isv_words_list.csv, 7993414 bytes, SHA-256 072DE8E512EB386780D199FBD6F0ACF2639D3096EA920F1AF2D0AFCC5535E842: row 11680 / ID 20046 gives poprědnji, poprědny, adjective type 1, previous; row 12178 / ID 14924 gives the rejected type-2 doublet prědhodny; row 13358 / ID 4061 gives raněje, adverb type 1, earlier.
evidence.official_grammar: Official adjectives.md, 8142 bytes, SHA-256 184348005ACB532868DAEB35DBFB7A8E05A493D550B4D6FA2E1A3BCFC906D84F: lines 14-18 require regular agreement by gender, case and number and establish hard/soft inflection. Every adjective target retains the source token's grammatical slot and capitalization.
evidence.german_authority: German ED0014 noether.tex, 2154011 bytes, SHA-256 EE226847656BC4D65EDDA9E9BF9BB1D25797C0C6D672D267D94A97FD88C7AD58: representative adjective control line 6459 has durch endlich viele vorangehende; the two adverbial sites align line 6904 den vorangehenden aufgenommenen and line 9246 Die eben erwähnte Folgerung, confirming previously accepted and previously mentioned meanings.
evidence.semantic_audit: Every one of the 49 sites was inspected in sentence context. Forty-seven are adjective agreement slots. Only base 7547:22 prědhodno prijetym and base 9979:1 Prědhodno spomenuty are adverbial. No occurrence denotes a literal predecessor person, spatial front, advance action, quotation or title.
evidence.independent_qa: A separate read-only agent independently reproduced all 49 locators and the 47/2 semantic split, official evidence, output hashes and structural invariants and returned ACCEPT with no defect.
evidence.protected_domains: No target lies in TeX math or comment state, a control name, label, citation key, URL, foreign-language/title argument, bibliography identity or formula token.

validation.coverage: The broad source-family census is exactly 49 and the ordered filename/line/column/token locator list matches all sites; the pre-existing poprědnyh control is separately counted.
validation.postcondition: All predhodn-/prědhodn- adjective and adverb tokens are zero; the poprědny family contains 48 tokens and raněje/Raněje counts are 10/1.
validation.structure: Line count, raw braces, ordered TeX-control stream and math-delimiter stream remain identical in all sources; bibliography is byte-identical.
validation.reproducibility: The independent read-only transform reproduced every declared output hash. The hash-gated applicator binds all four inputs/outputs, the complete histogram and exact ordered locator list and refuses drift.
